name: cortico-world-kookvoice
description: 让 Coopanion 的桌宠进 KOOK 语音频道：听得见频道里的说话声，被叫到就接话，用自己的声音说出来。

zh.description:
让桌宠真正进到 KOOK 的语音频道里：耳朵听频道里的说话声（系统环回 + 麦克风混音 → VAD → 本地识别），被叫到就用自己配的音色接话，声音走 KOOK 推流。文字也能触发——在语音频道自带的聊天框里打字，她会原样念出来。

引擎是独立的一套程序（Node + Python + GPT-SoVITS），本插件只负责启动、停止和显示状态，不重复造一份。

en.description:
Puts the desktop pet into a real KOOK voice channel: her ears are a loopback + microphone mix (VAD → local ASR), and she answers in her own GPT-SoVITS voice pushed as RTP. Typing in the voice channel's own chat box also works — she reads it aloud.

The engine is a separate program (Node + Python + GPT-SoVITS); this world only starts, stops and reports its status.
